company.name: Bosta
company.shortDescription: Bosta is a logistics and technology company that provides next-day delivery and fast transfer services to e-commerce businesses.
company.description: Bosta provides an on-demand courier app with a B2C focus, allowing users to send parcels to their customers. The platform connects its users to couriers and allows them to monitor the status of the delivery of the package. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and streamlining operations, it is committed to disrupting the logistics industry.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
